---
title: "Failure recovery"
---

After two or three back-to-back failures the agent often spirals. It retries the same approach, restates the same error, and never reaches for a debug tool. You want a Stop-event nudge that fires only when the recent transcript looks like a retry loop, and a separate per-failure nudge that points at the project's debugging playbook.

<!-- gd-embed: failure_recovery.py -->

`nudge(... signals=Signals(patterns=..., threshold=N, window=N))` matches against the *agent's narration* instead of tool inputs. Each of the last `window` transcript messages is scored on its own, and every pattern that matches adds its `weight` once. The nudge fires when a single message's score reaches `threshold`. With `threshold=4` here, one narration message has to hit two of the weight-2 phrases. The first nudge runs on `Event.Stop`; the second runs on `Event.PostToolUseFailure` and gates on a `when` predicate that counts the turn's failures. Combine `skip_if=[UsedSkill("codex"), ReadFile("DEBUGGING.md")]` so the nudge silences itself once the agent has already done the thing you'd suggest. See also [the signals guide](../guide/signals.qmd), [the primitives guide](../guide/primitives.qmd), and [the conditions reference](../reference/conditions.qmd).
